admission.justification: The producer-facing declaration, canonical guidance and distinct runtime/contract owners must agree across their locations; one path alone cannot preserve this message transport boundary.

applicability: Wake text supplied to registered role_message calls.
conditions: Read the effective roleMessageLimit on each call; count message text characters before constructing sender/file pointer lines.
exclusions: Full body/attachment payloads and full filed replies have no limit from this setting.
Plugin-authored host lifecycle lines are a distinct native event path, not a role_message settings-reload witness.
role_start assignment briefs and developer chat/host display are outside this message-text contract.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_role_message_files.py::MessageLimitTests (exact-limit, over-limit with count/limit, changed-number, non-whole-number); RegisteredRefusalTests through FastMCP; checks-attempt4/pytest-focused.log; worker report Attempt 4

statement: One role_message text holds at most the settings' orchestration.roleMessageLimit (default 1000 where unnamed), reloaded from the settings file on every call; sender and file lines are outside the count.
